metadata.description: Knowledge management and workflow automation plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Eval-driven improvement loop (keep/discard with a live Artifact dashboard) plus a dev-lifecycle harness builder that measures project health and creates feedback loops, evals, and sensors. Inspired by karpathy/autoresearch.

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Principle-aware PR review. Layers a repo-specific review-mindset agent on top of pr-review-toolkit's 4+6 perspectives, with configurable principle-directory roots.

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.description: Distill your writing voice into reusable tone presets and rewrite existing text to sound human (not AI) in zh-TW or English — meaning always preserved.

plugins.name: adhd-review
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly per-reply shaping merged with Review-Ready blocker/FYI handoff summaries. Shapes the human-facing thread only — subagent returns stay full-detail.

plugins.name: receipts
plugins.description: Stop-hook claim auditor — every **FACT:** / 'verified' / 'tests pass' claim must trace to a real tool call in the transcript, or Claude is flagged (or blocked, in block mode) until it proves the claim or downgrades it to **ASSUME:**. Hybrid deterministic prefilter + fresh-context Haiku judge. On by default (mode: warn), fail-open.

plugins.name: obsidian-kit
plugins.description: Work in an Obsidian vault with Claude Code: Excalidraw drawings in a house style, fixed note formats by note-type, a tag audit with one approved plan, and an obsidian CLI primer.
